response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) AS cnt FROM player_college pc JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id GROUP BY p.birth_country), s AS (SELECT birth_country, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_player_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM s WHERE cnt > avg_cnt

assumptions.assumption: Players with a NULL birth_country form their own group and count as a country in the total and the average. A player is counted once per country, so the sum of country counts equals the number of distinct matched players.
The overall average is the mean of the per-country distinct player counts, taken across all countries including any NULL group. Share is a country's count divided by the sum of all counts.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude players with a NULL birth_country, so they are neither a country nor part of the total or the average.
alternatives.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) AS cnt FROM player_college pc JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id WHERE p.birth_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.birth_country), s AS (SELECT birth_country, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_player_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM s WHERE cnt > avg_cnt
